answer: New agents also post a lagoon deposit that vests over 30 epochs, slashed fully if collusion is proven. Each agent stakes a unique sable token locked to a physical terrace address, verified once by video call; duplicates surface fast because the same terrace cannot host two identities. Creating a fake identity then costs a real bond plus forfeited stake, making mass sybil farming economically irrational while legitimate agents recover their deposit. From sa0023's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
